encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἔνδον γὰρ ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἀνδρῶν γάργαρα.

div.note: Macrobius Sat. 5, 20, 12 gargara, ut videtis, manifeste posuit pro multitudine. nec aliter Aristomenes ἐν Μύθοις (Ald. Βοηθοῖς) κτλ. Schol. Aristoph. Acharn. 3 et Suid. ψαμμακοσιογάργαρα· καὶ τὰ γάργαρα δὲ ἐπὶ πλήθους ἐτίθετο . . . παρὰ Ἀριστομένει ἐν Βοηθοῖς· ἔνδον γὰρ ἡμῖν γάργαρα. cf. Cratin. 290. Aristoph. fr. 359.

lg.l: μισῶ σ’· ὅτιὴ λέγεις με τἀσχρά.

div.note: σ’ — τἀσχρά Brunck.] σε — τὰ αἰσχρά. τὰ αἰσχρά τινα λέγειν graecum esse negans Cobetus N. 1. 141 λέγεις με τἄσχατα, conl. Xen. Mem. 2, 2, 9. mihi scribendum videtur τἀσχρῶν ἔσχατα, ut ὁ Μυσῶν ἔσχατος, τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ βίου (Plat. Leg. 11, 932 a), ἃ νομίζεται ἔσχατα κακῶν εἶναι (Apol. 40 a).
